calibration_boundary: Community Pipeline MAGZERO supplies internally repeatable instrumental-characterization magnitudes but is not treated as final native-band AB calibration.
At this declination the documented Community Pipeline reference is Gaia G regardless of DECam filter, producing stable band-dependent offsets.
The validation score therefore uses the complete three-color mapping frozen from development objects. No validation-dependent zeropoint or color term is allowed.
Passing validates color consistency for these provisional singleton pairs only; it does not establish scientific total fluxes or stellar masses.
claim_boundary: V19AT is a once-only internal validation of one frozen image measurement and color-transfer rule on five provisional singleton pairs.
A pass authorizes only a separately frozen ambiguous-candidate image likelihood. It does not authorize an association, stellar mass, mass current, lensing or gravity claim.
A failure closes this exact four-arcsecond area-scaled route; it cannot be rescued by inspecting another aperture or deblending variant on validation.
No absolute AB-photometry claim is made because a separate field-star/color calibration remains required.

frozen_measurement.exposure_selection: none; retain every validation measurement membership
frozen_measurement.implementation: Reuse the hash-bound V19AS background, watershed, aperture and area-scaling functions without modification.
